hypothesis: With frozen original S1 native 45 coefficients, a receiving cell can use its own charged public post-action prediction error to select two local/second-neighbor message routes without additional trainable model weights or a global learned router; retention of old function and superiority are NOT assumed.
research_north_star: Tokenless developmental substrate: locally governed topology change, bounded resources, persistent state and no global hidden-law oracle.

fixed_mechanism.native_model: Original S1 LocalPredictiveMessages45, 3x7 shared genomic + 8x3 local roles (45), 8 episodic scalar states; no S1 changes
fixed_mechanism.candidates: For each receiver i: left source i-1 or i-2, right source i+1 or i+2 modulo 8; four ordered configurations, no self-links and no duplicate endpoints.
fixed_mechanism.evidence: Only frozen same-weight PREACTION predictions and the genuine after-action public local outcome; never a private source state or counterfactual world action.
fixed_mechanism.score: Sum of squared preaction Bernoulli error per candidate, over successive 32 genuine source events; candidate scoring may inspect the four two-hop candidate scalar messages, so development input budget exceeds inference input budget and MUST be disclosed.
fixed_mechanism.selection: Every 32 events, select the lowest-score candidate per cell with stable integer-index tie break. Change only if candidate cumulative error + 0.10 is STRICTLY less than current candidate cumulative error. Each cell may change at most twice, no more than one change per 32-event window. On invalid/insufficient evidence preserve current routing.
fixed_mechanism.envelope: Exactly 16 active inbound scalar references per prediction (2 per cell), at most 64 training candidate scalar references per event plus fixed local feature computation; 45 original native weight values untouched by structural-score branch; 32 persistent bounded score scalars (256 float64-equivalent bytes), 8 choice integers (implementation size reported), eight switch counters and epoch count; no additional learned neural weight tensors.
fixed_mechanism.schedule: Run only after separately trained S1 checkpoint and source provenance are frozen; train=False is inference-only state update and MUST NOT change structural scores or edges. No postresult adaptation of the frozen schedule.
fixed_mechanism.cold: Canonical bounded snapshot binds original S1 source-native state and all structural learning state; exact restore required. Default ring and 45 parameters unchanged in parent.

controls: Original source-native S1 ring, equal observed events
Fully trained conventional recurrent and current-only controls
Matched capacity graph routing and permutation negative controls
scientific_primary: Prospective held-out source-native preaction Brier improvement across independently authored unfamiliar causal source families after independently authenticated first-use and source/seed custody.
scientific_stop: NO_GO if no independent structural signal, matching fixed/random topology controls, any old-function loss, negative cross-family transfer, nonportable learned state, source/actor drift, or excess full-process CPU/peak RSS/storage/communication; protect negative outcomes and do not retune after seeing results.
exclusions: No protected cohorts, no runner/controller/scheduler changes, no accepted main, no original S1/S2 source/threshold edits, no model deployment, no paid API, no Cross-project integration.
